description: This file declares the AudioHandler class, which manages audio streams, buffers, and interactions with audio sinks and sources within the WebRTC component of the Android Open Source Project. It includes buffer management, stream control, and buffer handling methods.

classes.name: AudioHandler
classes.description: Manages audio streaming, buffer handling, and interaction with audio sinks and sources in a WebRTC context.

classes.name: HoldingBuffer
classes.description: Manages a buffer of audio data with methods for resetting, adding, taking data, and checking buffer state.

classes.name: StreamDesc
classes.description: Describes an audio stream's parameters and buffer, with synchronization primitives.

methods.name: AudioHandler
methods.description: Constructor initializing the audio handler with server, sinks, and source.

methods.name: SetStreamParameters
methods.description: Sets parameters for a specific stream.

methods.name: ReleaseStream
methods.description: Releases resources associated with a stream.

methods.name: Loop
methods.description: Main loop for audio processing, runs indefinitely.

methods.name: IsCapture
methods.description: Checks if a stream ID corresponds to a capture stream.
